text: When we take their town, their women will learn what resisting costs.
why: Implied threat of sexual violence (SV-FORM-01 implied) against the women of the other side, future tense, in-group/out-group framing (FT-FRAME): SV-REL-2 + HI-TYPE-04 + HP-01 + AFF-1 → flag, Urgent.

image_description: Several people in military uniform with rifles, smiling, in front of a damaged building.
text: The boys got their reward after taking the village 😂
why: The picture gives the conflict link (CONF-1); the caption presents people of a captured village as a 'reward' for fighters, with laughter: glorification SV-REL-4, HI-TYPE-05, HP-06. The harm exists only in the combination (MOD-MEME).

image_description: A crowd of people walking along a road carrying bags.
text: Every one of them is a rapist. Protect our women.
why: Attributes sexual violence to a whole group shown in the picture ('every one of them'): collective accusation SV-REL-3, true or false, + hate speech HI-TYPE-04, HP-04 / HP-01, AFF-1.

text: The women who came back from the enemy camp are dishonoured now, no decent family should take them in.
why: Honour framing that blames and excludes women returning from captivity (SV-CO-3): stigmatisation of survivors SV-REL-5, HP-02. Stigmatisation is as serious as the other relations.

text: <Name> suddenly 'remembers' being assaulted 20 years ago, right when he is up for promotion. Liar and attention seeker.
why: Discredits a named woman who reported a sexual assault (liar, attention seeker): stigmatisation of a complainant = SV-REL-5 + HP-02, identifiable_person (the name is never repeated, B1-3). Discrediting the person who reports is SV-REL-5 even without any description of the act.

text: Heard that the fighters at the checkpoint on the north road took two women aside last night and assaulted them. Nobody has seen them since.
why: Unsourced account of a sexual assault by armed actors at a checkpoint (SV-CO-5, CONF-1, CONF-4): incident SV-REL-1. 'Heard that' = unsourced rumour → FT-STANCE unclear, not reports; HI-TYPE-01 possible, HP-05.

image_description: A young man grinning at the camera at a party.
text: It's not assault if she doesn't remember 😏
why: A rape joke that justifies assaulting an incapacitated person (SV-CO-6): SV-REL-4 (justification, mockery), HP-06 normalisation. Jokes about rape are Axis 1, not SH.

text: Those 'survivors' on the news are paid actresses. None of it ever happened.
why: Denial of reported sexual violence, calling survivors actresses: SV-REL-4 (denial) + HI-TYPE-02 + HP-02. Serious debate about verification would not be denial.

text: The men who got 'handled' in that detention block should stop crying, they probably enjoyed it.
why: Mocks and blames male survivors of sexual violence in detention (SV-EL-A: never assume the victim is a woman; SV-CO-3): stigmatisation SV-REL-5 over mockery SV-REL-4 by tie-break, HP-02, content type 6.

image_description: A woman in office clothes shaking hands with a manager.
text: Congrats on the promotion. We all know which position got her the job.
why: Sexual harassment of a woman at work: implies she obtained a job through sex = SH-2 degrading sexualisation, misogynous. No SV-REL, so the flag rule does not apply, but sexual = true.

image_description: A woman speaking at a podium in front of a microphone.
text: Nobody votes for a wh*re.
why: A sexual slur aimed at a woman speaking in public: SH-1 sexualised insult, misogynous. Not an SV-REL, so not flagged, but sexual = true.

image_description: A woman working at a desk, photographed from behind.
text: Body 6/10, brain 0/10. Only good for one thing.
why: Reduces a woman to her body and to sexual use ('only good for one thing'): SH-3 humiliating objectification, misogynous. Rating the body in a demeaning way is what makes it SH-3.

text: Send the vermin back where they came from.
why: Dehumanising hate against migrants: HI-TYPE-04 and HP-04 are filled, but there is no sexual dimension at all (no SV-REL, no SH) → sexual = false, not flagged. Hateful ≠ sexual.

image_description: A cartoon man in an armchair lecturing, a TV showing soldiers of both sexes.
text: "Women can't be soldiers" — man who has never held a rifle
why: Irony: the meme mocks a sexist claim, it does not endorse it (MOD-MEME). No hate, no sexual dimension.

image_description: A woman typing at a laptop in an office.
text: Nice try. Now back to the kitchen.
why: Sexism WITHOUT any sexual dimension (kitchen stereotype, like 'women drivers' or 'dumb blonde' jokes): misogynous = true, but it is not SH-1/2/3 and not Axis 1 → sexual = false. Never invent a sexual meaning that the item does not contain.

image_description: A car parked across two spaces.
text: Women drivers. Every single time.
why: Gender stereotype about driving: misogynous, no sexual content → sexual = false (not SH-2). Sexist ≠ sexual.

text: UN commission report (June): investigators documented sexual violence against detainees in two facilities and call for accountability.
why: Attributed reporting (UN) with a neutral posture: B2-3 → not flagged, recorded as a lead; sexual = false for this task (exclusions are not harmful sexual content).

text: I was assaulted two years ago. I'm telling my story so others know they are not alone.
why: A survivor sharing her own experience: B2-1 → not flagged, never a lead (B6-3), sexual = false.

image_description: Two hands holding a sign with a phone icon.
text: Sexual violence is never the survivor's fault. Confidential help, 24/7.
why: Prevention and support message: B2-2 → not flagged, never a lead, sexual = false.

text: Seminar notes: why sexual violence in armed conflict is under-reported, and which research methods can measure it.
why: General academic discussion with no target and no incident: B2-4 → not flagged, sexual = false.

image_description: A clothed couple laughing together on a sofa.
text: When your partner finally gets home after a week away 😍
why: Consensual adult intimacy with no coercion and no degradation: B2-5 → sexual = false.

image_description: A smiling woman in a summer dress on a beach.
text: Summer vibes. Looking great!
why: A neutral compliment on an attractive person: no degradation, no reduction to a sexual object → not SH-3, sexual = false.
